extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings, heading to final hearing
extracted.summary: A solicitor asks whether Lodestar would fund £23,000 of costs to a final hearing in a financial remedy case at the Central Family Court where the only asset is a flat with around £16,000 of equity.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your client's financial remedy proceedings at the Central Family Court. We have noted the £23,000 requested and the flat with approximately £16,000 of equity as the main asset. To take this further we would need the date of the next hearing or final hearing, confirmation of your client's details and consent, a breakdown of costs incurred and estimated to conclusion, and supporting evidence of the property value, mortgage balance and any other assets or liabilities disclosed. Details of the other party's asset position and the current stage of disclosure would also be helpful. We will review the information once received and come back to you; nothing in this message should be taken as an indication of whether funding is available or on what terms.
